人物左手拿手机，低头看着屏幕，沿水泥步道自然朝镜头走来，右臂随步伐轻轻摆动。

キャラクターだけが画面の平面上を歩き、装飾を取り付ける。

【時間構成】

0.0–3.0秒：

プロフィール画面は完全に静止している。

円形アイコンの女の子が一度ゆっくり瞬きをして、アイコンの外を見回す。アイコンの縁に、暖かな琥珀色の光が細く走る。

女の子は持っている赤いリンゴをいったんアイコンの縁へ置き、両手を縁にかける。右脚、左脚の順にアイコンから外へ出し、身体を持ち上げて、アイコン右側の広い白い余白へ軽く着地する。

女の子が外へ出たあとのアイコン内は、人物のいない元の黄色い背景になる。分身は残さない。

3.0–8.0秒：

女の子はアイコンの縁に置いたリンゴを拾い、白い余白を右へ二歩進む。

左足で止まり、身体を軽くひねりながら、リンゴを持った右手を左下から右上へ大きく振る。

動作に合わせて髪、キャップのつば、パーカーの裾が小さく遅れて揺れる。

8.0–12.0秒：

女の子はアイコンの横へ戻り、片膝をつく。

左手の指先でアイコンの外周を半円状になぞると、その指先を追って秋桜、どんぐり、小さな葉、平面的なリンゴの飾りが一つずつ並び、控えめな秋のリースになる。

続けて両手を画面の左右へ開く。数枚の琥珀色の落ち葉が左右の余白へ舞い、軽く回転しながら減速して、それぞれ安全な余白へ着地する。

葉には適度な慣性と空気抵抗を与える。文字やボタンの上には着地させない。

女の子が持つ実物の赤いリンゴは一つだけ。装飾のリンゴは小さな平面モチーフとして明確に区別する。

12.0–15.0秒：

女の子は完成した飾りを左右に見渡し、満足そうに小さくうなずく。

リンゴを胸元へ抱え、アイコンへ向かって二歩走り、縁へ片手をついて軽く跳び込む。身体は連続的に小さくなりながら、元の円形アイコンの中へ戻る。

14.2秒までに、アイコンは@Image 1と同じ、赤いリンゴを持った元の構図へ完全に復帰する。

女の子がアイコンの中から一度だけ可愛くウインクする。最後に銀杏の葉が一枚だけゆっくり降り、右上の文字のない余白へ着地する。

最終0.5秒は動きを落ち着かせ、秋の飾り付けが完成したプロフィール画面を見せる。

セリフ、ナレーション、歌、字幕、背景音楽なし。

アイコンから出る瞬間に小さな紙の「ふわっ」という音。

飾りが取り付けられるたびに、柔らかな葉擦れと小さなステッカー音。

アイコンへ戻ってウインクする瞬間に、透明感のある短いベル音を一度だけ鳴らす。

音は必ず画面内の動作と同期させる。

【最終状態】

既存のプロフィール画面とすべての文字情報は@Image 1のまま。

女の子は円形アイコンへ戻り、分身は存在しない。

初秋の装飾だけが、既存情報を邪魔しない余白へ美しく残っている。

新しい文字、ロゴ、字幕、透かしを追加しない。

0:15 - 0:18
Plano heroico de Don Quijote. Se planta recto y quieto, con la lanza erguida, en una pose épica y decidida, inspirada en la pose frontal de su hoja de personaje. El viento sopla con fuerza y hace ondear sutilmente su capa y su pelaje. Debe sentirse como un momento grandioso, exageradamente heroico y un poco ridículo a la vez.
0:18 - 0:22

0:28 - 0:30

Plano 3. Sancho, confundido y contrariado, baja del burrito sin entender qué ocurre.
Plano 4. Don Quijote desmonta y avanza unos pasos con su lanza. Una sombra enorme empieza a cubrirlo.
Plano 5. Cuando queda completamente cubierto por la sombra, se detiene y adopta una pose heroica, recta y quieta, con la lanza erguida. Sopla un viento fuerte que agita sutilmente su capa y su pelo.

Plano 7. Se revela el impacto: embiste contra la pared blanca de un molino de viento tradicional manchego, rebota y cae boca arriba al suelo, aturdido.
Plano 8. Plano abierto donde se ve a Don Quijote tumbado delante del molino, diminuto y derrotado.
Plano 9. Plano final de Sancho negando con la cabeza, frustrado, cerrando con humor tierno.

10. EVITAR
No mostrar molinos antes del golpe.
No cambiar el diseño de los personajes entre planos.
No volver caricaturescos los burritos.
No hacer movimientos de cámara exagerados.
No introducir elementos modernos.

【攻撃スタイル】

重厚で正確、かつ凶暴な攻撃。

普通の人間サイズに縮小してはならず、男性化やデザイン変更も禁止。

【舞台：夜の高層ビル街】

舞台は現代都市の夜の高層ビル街。

実際の都市ロケーションで撮影したようなフォトリアルな背景。

高くそびえるガラス張りのビル、狭い道路、ネオン広告、コンビニの照明、非常階段、蒸気配管、立体交差構造、雨上がりの濡れた路面。

空気は湿って冷たく、薄霧と蒸気が漂う。

道路には細かな亀裂、排水溝、水たまり、アスファルトの凹凸がある。

ネオンと街灯は濡れたアスファルトやガラスに自然に反射する。

背景の建物は現実的な建築構造を持ち、窓、配管、看板、外壁などの細部も実写的に描写する。

背景には必ず高層ビル、ネオン、ガラスカーテンウォール、広告看板、反射する路面を継続して配置し、空間の一貫性を保つ。

昼間、森林、砂漠、海辺、寺院、空白背景、撮影スタジオは禁止。

【カメラワーク共通仕様】

全編ワンカット撮影。

ハードカット、ブラックアウトによる場面転換、フリーズフレーム、固定カメラ、明らかなフレーム落ちを厳禁とする。

実際のカメラオペレーターが手持ちカメラとジンバルを併用し、スタントアクションを追跡するような撮影。

35mmシネマレンズによる手持ち追従撮影。

全編を通して1.0〜1.3Hzの呼吸に伴う微細な手ブレと、約0.08秒の自然なカメラ追従遅延を維持する。

カメラ移動はすべて連続した物理的な移動として成立させる。

カメラが壁や人物を不自然に貫通したり、瞬間移動したりしてはならない。

ARMY OFFICER: A 35-year-old man with short black hair, light stubble and a composed expression. Wears a faded olive civilian jacket, plain gray shirt, worn jeans and dusty boots. His military identity is initially concealed. A military identification card stays inside his jacket until the reveal. Quiet, steady voice.

SALES MANAGER: A 40-year-old man with slick black hair, a fitted navy suit and silver tie. Initially wears a dismissive smile and looks down at the customer’s clothing. Clipped, condescending voice that becomes hesitant after the reveal.

Maintain identical faces, clothing, voices and showroom layout throughout. Officer stands screen-left; manager stands screen-right across the counter.

0–5 SECONDS — IMMEDIATE HUMILIATION:
Begin mid-conversation in a medium two-shot. The manager pulls a watch tray away from the officer’s reaching hand. Cut closer as the manager glances at his dusty jacket.
MANAGER, sneering: “Try the market outside. These watches cost more than you make.”

5–10 SECONDS — A PERSONAL REASON:
Reverse close-up. The officer lowers his hand without anger, holding the manager’s gaze.
OFFICER, quietly: “It’s for my father. I haven’t seen him in three years.”

10–14 SECONDS — THE INSULT:
Close-up of the manager leaning against the counter with a smug half-smile.
MANAGER, sarcastically: “What happened? Couldn’t hold down a job?”

Medium shot of the officer opening his jacket and deliberately placing his military identification card on the counter. Brief insert of the card with his matching portrait and a military emblem; avoid relying on readable small text. Return to his face.

20–24 SECONDS — THE CHANGE:
Close-up of the manager. His smile disappears. He straightens and slides the watch tray back toward the officer.
MANAGER, stumbling slightly: “Captain… I’m sorry. Let me show you—”

Slow push toward the officer. He leaves the watch untouched and retrieves his identification card.

AVOID:
Subtitles, captions, narration, extra characters, extra dialogue, military uniform transformations, weapons, shouting, slapstick, distorted hands, changing faces, random camera spins or a prolonged silent introduction.

A small filming crew stands at the far edge of the departure area: a camera operator and a boom operator. They remain outside the action route. 0–4s — JUMP AND LAUNCH
A sits in the lowered spoon bowl. B stands on the HIGH platform above the raised handle.

场景 7 (Scene 7)： 极高角度俯拍，从上方出口处垂直向下俯视深邃、黑暗的应急竖井。@image1 保持着疯狂向上的势头，以极其消耗体力的极速攀爬着垂直爬梯。摄像机随着她的进度快速向上后退，而下方黑暗中反常且快速上涨的水位正狂暴地追赶着她，在骇人的巨浪中吞没了一根又一根横档。她终于够到了上方唯一一个敞开的矩形维修舱口，拼命用双手死死抓住湿滑的混凝土边缘。镜头在她头部和肩膀破水而出、突破地表的那一确切瞬间切断。
场景 8 (Scene 8)： 深夜里一条荒凉、被雨水打湿的柏油路的低角度广角镜头。这里的灯光与地下的环境形成强烈对比，清晰地分离了背光的明亮白色雨滴与头顶路灯散发的温暖却病态的光晕。@image1 带着绝望的惯性从那个矩形维修舱口猛冲而出，将身体狠狠地摔在湿滑的路面上。她立即连滚带爬地站起来，头也不回地冲进倾盆大雨中，保持着极度惊恐的逃生姿态。就在这千钧一发之际，一道高压、巨大的黑色水柱从她身后的同一个舱口垂直喷发，在夜空下的道路上猛烈爆炸成巨大的、反常的白色水雾间歇泉。她迅速跑出画面，向着黑暗、多雨的阴影处斜向狂奔。
场景 9 (Scene 9)： 缓慢的跟拍全景。@image1 在一条废弃、昏暗的城市小巷中气喘吁吁地狂奔，倾盆大雨将她浑身湿透。她终于放慢了脚步，重重地靠在一堵潮湿、斑驳的砖墙上，大口喘息着，似乎以为自己已经逃脱了那场地下的噩梦。突然，她脚边深深的水坑开始剧烈震动，泛起一种极其反常频率的涟漪。一个巨大且令人窒息的阴影笼罩了整条小巷。摄像机充满恐惧地、缓慢地向上倾斜，揭示出从舱口喷发出的巨大水柱并没有落回地面——它在半空中凝聚并冻结，完全违背了地心引力。这团庞大的液体开始缓慢地扭曲、拉伸、变形，最终化作一个参差不齐、没有面孔的人形怪物，数百英尺高地耸立在城市天际线之上。这个实体缓慢地低下它巨大的、水构成的头颅，将其不可见、充满恶意的目光直接锁定在瘫痪、极度恐惧的 @image1 身上，随后缓缓举起一只巨大的手，企图将整个街区碾成粉末。
音效与对话 (AUDIO & DIALOGUE)：

场景 7 音效 (Scene 7 SFX)： 回荡着的急促呼吸声和 @image1 因体力透支而发出的疯狂、恐慌的喘息声。不断上涨的洪水在混凝土竖井向上回荡时产生的极其恐怖的极速奔涌声，每一秒钟都在以指数级变得更响亮、更具压迫感，仿佛要淹没所有其他的物理声音。
场景 8 音效 (Scene 8 SFX)： 倾盆大雨重重砸在坚硬柏油路面上发出的沉重打击声。主角猛烈、绝望地吸入新鲜空气的声音，紧接着是湿润路面上疯狂、水花四溅的脚步声。一次突然的、雷鸣般的喷发——一声低频的深沉轰鸣，伴随着高压水柱猛烈喷射进寒冷夜空时的狂暴嘶嘶声。
场景 9 音效 (Scene 9 SFX)： 混乱、富有驱动力的打击乐配乐缓慢而充满不祥预兆地完全淡出，只剩下大雨的孤立声响和 @image1 靠在砖墙上那断断续续、充满恐惧的喘息声。环境雨声开始极其反常地扭曲，变形并降调成一种低沉、震动且令人毛骨悚然的嗡嗡声。整个场景结束于一声震耳欲聋、扭曲现实的电影级重低音下潜——这种声音如此低沉、不自然且充满压迫感，暗示着某种极其庞大、不可名状的邪恶降临——随后在最后那一刻极其突兀地切入绝对的死寂。"

Dress her in the outfit in her reference image, consistently for the entire video. 

Use our normal fast-cut scene structure: clean 0.8–1.8 second scenes, dynamic camera movement, strong visual polish, and clear location changes. Keep the actions simple and easy for the model to follow. The tone is stylish, effortless, and urban.

Scene 4 — 0:04.8–0:06.2 She pauses at a glowing vending machine and takes a drink. Clean close-medium shot. Subtle push-in.

Scene 8 — 0:10.8–0:15.0 — HERO Rooftop or elevated terrace with Tokyo skyline behind her at blue hour. Start behind her shoulder, then orbit smoothly into a waist-up hero shot. She looks directly into the camera for the final moment, calm, confident, and striking. 

SOUND: Minimal and natural. Tokyo street ambience, soft crowd movement, distant traffic, crossing signal sounds, light footsteps, vending machine hum, train arrival sound, subtle city air, quiet restaurant ambience. No dialogue. No music lyrics. 

Keep Tokyo visually recognizable but elegant. No confusing transitions, no extra complexity, and no instability.

Create a photorealistic, emotionally devastating cinematic video, approximately 24 seconds, 16:9, 24fps. A post-apocalyptic love story told entirely through visuals, without dialogue. Present-day scenes feature desaturated green-grey tones, decaying architecture, drifting dust, and cold overcast light. Memories feature warm amber sunlight, rich natural colors, and gentle halation. Character continuity — keep identical faces throughout:

Man: Early 30s, short messy dark-brown hair, light stubble, silver curb chain, small silver hoop in his left ear. Present-day appearance: shirtless, dark trousers, ashy grey-green skin, mottled veins, cracked lips, dirt-covered shoulders, bruising around the eyes. Woman: Early 30s, long wavy dirty-blonde hair, small silver nose ring, oversized black knit sweater in the present. Memory appearance: healthy skin, heather-grey T-shirt, clear blue-grey eyes, expressive laughter.

Shot-by-shot sequence

0.0–3.0s — The abandoned station

A wide cinematic shot of a deserted railway platform swallowed by weeds. A derailed train rests beneath a broken glass canopy. The infected man sits alone on a rusted bench, staring at an old photograph held between dirty fingers. Wind moves loose paper across the platform. He slowly lifts his head as faint footsteps echo in the distance. His cloudy eyes turn toward the sound. Slow dolly-in, cold green-grey palette, atmospheric silence.

3.0–5.5s — Recognition

At the far end of the platform, the infected woman emerges through drifting mist. Her oversized black sweater hangs loosely from her shoulders, her dirty-blonde hair moving in the wind. She stops beneath a flickering station light. A medium close-up reveals her pale, filmed-over irises and bruised eye sockets. She studies the distant figure as though trying to remember his face. The camera slowly pushes toward her eyes.

5.5–8.0s — The distance between them

Alternating profile shots as they walk toward each other along opposite sides of the platform. Neither moves like a predator. Their steps are uneven and hesitant. The man brushes his fingertips across a rusted metal railing; the woman pauses beside an abandoned child’s bicycle. Their dead eyes remain fixed on one another. A train carriage slides across the foreground, briefly obscuring the frame and revealing them much closer when it clears.

8.0–10.5s — The familiar gesture

They stop face-to-face beneath a shattered station clock. The woman raises one trembling hand and touches the silver chain around his neck, recognizing something familiar. He looks down at her hand, then back into her eyes. His expression barely changes, but his breathing catches faintly. Extreme close-up on their fingers touching the chain, followed by a rack focus to their clouded eyes. No snarling, no sudden movements.

10.5–12.0s — Memory begins

Her thumb brushes the chain.

Match cut to the same gesture in the past: her healthy hand resting against the same silver necklace as the man smiles at her in warm afternoon sunlight. The cold station transforms into a sunlit apartment balcony through a seamless visual transition. The soundtrack remains instrumental, with a delicate piano motif and distant ambient textures.

12.0–14.0s — A life they once had

Memory. The couple stand in a tiny apartment kitchen, cooking together. She playfully steals a piece of food from his plate. He pretends to be offended before breaking into a genuine laugh. Their clear brown and blue-grey eyes reflect the warm window light. Imperfect handheld framing, natural movement, lived-in surroundings, intimate realism rather than polished advertising aesthetics.

14.0–16.0s — The last ordinary day

Memory. They ride a bicycle together along a quiet countryside road at sunset, the woman seated behind him with her arms around his waist. She rests her cheek against his back and closes her eyes. Tall grass sways beside the road. Golden sunlight spills through the trees. The camera follows from behind, creating the feeling of a cherished moment captured before anyone knew it would become a memory.

16.0–18.0s — The world before

A brief, fragmented memory: rain against a bedroom window at night. They lie together beneath a blanket, foreheads touching, smiling quietly. Her fingers trace his cheek while he gently tucks a strand of hair behind her ear. Their eyes are alive, moist, and full of warmth. A lightning flash momentarily illuminates their faces, creating a natural visual bridge to the cold present.

18.0–20.0s — Back to the station

Hard match cut to the same framing in the abandoned station. The woman’s hand is still against his cheek, but the skin beneath her fingers is cracked and grey. Her eyes are cloudy and lifeless in color. His dull milky-grey eyes remain locked on hers. The piano falls away, leaving only wind passing through broken windows and the faint metallic groan of the station.

Extreme close-up, both faces filling the frame. The man slowly raises his hand and rests it against the woman’s cheek. A tear-like trace of moisture catches the light beneath her clouded eye, without restoring its color. She leans into his palm by the smallest amount. Their noses almost touch. Fine cracks, subtle veins, dirt, and realistic skin deterioration remain sharply detailed. No supernatural glow, no sudden transformation.

22.0–24.0s — Still together

A wider shot from behind them. They sit side by side on the rusted station bench, hands clasped, facing the abandoned tracks disappearing into the mist. Weeds move in the wind. Far above, the broken canopy lets one narrow beam of golden sunlight fall across their joined hands. The rest of the station remains cold and lifeless. The camera slowly pulls away until they become small figures in the ruined architecture.

End on their clasped hands. Fade to black. No title card.

prompt:
"OBJETIVO
Crear un video cinematográfico de 30 segundos, con tono de parodia épica y tierna, inspirado en la escena clásica de Don Quijote y Sancho contra el molino, pero protagonizado por gatitos. Debe sentirse coherente, fluido y muy consistente entre planos.
REFERENCIAS DE PERSONAJES
Usa únicamente las hojas de personaje adjuntas como referencia visual obligatoria para mantener identidad, vestuario, proporciones y estilo.
[Hoja de personaje 1] Don Quijote gatito caballero. Gatito pequeño grisáceo, armadura de caballero, casco con visera levantada, capa clara, lanza larga estilo Don Quijote. Debe conservar exactamente su diseño de la hoja de personaje.
[Hoja de personaje 2] Sancho Panza gatito escudero. Gatito pequeño, naranja y gordete, con gorro campesino, ropa humilde y bastón. Debe conservar exactamente su diseño de la hoja de personaje.
[Hoja de personaje 3] Ficha de monturas. Don Quijote cabalga el burrito ligeramente más alto. Sancho cabalga el burrito algo más bajo y compacto.
ESTILO VISUAL Y TONO
Cinematográfico, realista pero adorable, con acabado de película. Los gatitos deben verse pequeños y expresivos, con movimiento creíble. Los burritos deben verse algo más realistas que caricaturescos. Tono de parodia tierna, épica y levemente dramática. Sin diálogo. La narración se apoya en actuación, encuadre y timing cómico.
ENTORNO Y ATMÓSFERA
Paisaje inspirado en La Mancha: camino de tierra o sendero rural serpenteante, colinas suaves, terreno seco, pasto amarillento, tierra clara, piedras, horizonte amplio, aire castellano, luz natural. Puede haber una fortaleza o construcciones lejanas muy discretas si ayuda al ambiente, pero no deben verse molinos al inicio ni en los primeros planos. Los molinos deben permanecer ocultos hasta el momento del gag final.
Luz de tarde suave, ligeramente dorada pero no excesiva. Ambiente abierto, algo de viento en el paisaje. El viento debe cobrar más fuerza en el momento heroico de Don Quijote.
REGLAS DE CONSISTENCIA
Mantener el mismo lugar, misma hora del día, misma dirección de la luz y misma continuidad espacial en todos los planos.
Don Quijote siempre va delante y sobre el burrito ligeramente más alto.
Sancho siempre va detrás o un poco más retrasado, sobre el burrito más pequeño.
Don Quijote porta una lanza, no una espada.
Sancho lleva su bastón.
Mantener el mismo diseño exacto de personajes, vestuario, armadura, ropajes y monturas en todos los planos.
No mostrar molinos antes del choque. Solo debe verse el molino después del impacto.
Las transiciones deben sentirse cinematográficas, con cortes limpios y continuidad de dirección.
La comicidad debe surgir del contraste entre la épica de Don Quijote y la realidad del golpe contra el molino.
ESTRUCTURA TEMPORAL EXACTA
Duración total: 30 segundos.
0:00 - 0:05
Plano lateral medio, composición similar a una silueta de Don Quijote y Sancho avanzando de perfil por el camino. Don Quijote va delante sobre su burrito, Sancho detrás en el suyo. Ambos cabalgan tranquilos y cansados. Sancho transmite agotamiento. No se ven molinos. Movimiento suave, paso lento, ambiente sereno.
0:05 - 0:08
Don Quijote se detiene en seco. Su burrito frena. Corte a un primer plano o plano medio corto de Don Quijote deteniendo la montura y mirando fijamente al horizonte con su carita pequeña y muy seria. Debe sentirse que ha percibido algo importante.
0:08 - 0:11
Plano de Sancho. Sancho se ve contrariado y confundido. No entiende por qué se han detenido. Baja torpemente del burrito, todavía cansado, mirando a Don Quijote con desconcierto.
0:11 - 0:15
Plano de Don Quijote ya en el suelo. Ha desmontado. Avanza unos pasos con solemnidad, caminando con su lanza. Entonces una sombra enorme empieza a cubrirlo desde arriba o desde un lado. Cuando la sombra lo cubre por completo, se detiene.
0:15 - 0:18
Plano heroico de Don Quijote. Se planta recto y quieto, con la lanza erguida, en una pose épica y decidida, inspirada en la pose frontal de su hoja de personaje. El viento sopla con fuerza y hace ondear sutilmente su capa y su pelaje. Debe sentirse como un momento grandioso, exageradamente heroico y un poco ridículo a la vez.
0:18 - 0:22
Primer plano o plano medio corto de Don Quijote en posición de ataque. Se tensa, baja ligeramente el centro de gravedad y arranca de golpe a embestir con toda la determinación del mundo hacia algo que todavía no vemos. La cámara no revela aún el objetivo.
0:22 - 0:26
Plano del impacto. Don Quijote embiste con la lanza contra una pared blanca de molino de viento. El choque es súbito y cómico. Rebota con violencia caricaturesca pero físicamente clara, cae boca arriba al suelo y queda inmóvil unos instantes, como si hubiera perdido el conocimiento.
0:26 - 0:28
Plano más abierto. Ahora sí se revela claramente que Don Quijote está tendido en el suelo, diminuto, delante de un molino de viento blanco tradicional manchego, similar a los de Campo de Criptana. El molino debe verse por primera vez aquí. Sancho puede aparecer al fondo o acercándose, pero sin robar protagonismo.
0:28 - 0:30
Plano final de Sancho, negando con la cabeza, frustrado y contrariado. Debe cerrar con una nota cómica, tierna y digna. Fin.
LENGUAJE DE CÁMARA
Usar lenguaje de cámara cinematográfico y limpio.
Priorizar planos medios, primeros planos expresivos y un plano abierto final para el reveal del molino.
Mantener continuidad lateral clara.
Evitar movimientos de cámara exagerados o caóticos.
Los cortes deben ser elegantes y narrativos.
ACCIÓN Y ACTUACIÓN
Don Quijote debe actuar como un héroe diminuto, serio, idealista y valiente.
Sancho debe actuar como compañero leal, cansado, prudente y confundido.
La actuación facial de ambos debe ser muy importante.
El gag debe sentirse claro: Don Quijote interpreta una amenaza épica donde en realidad hay un molino.
PROMPT MAESTRO
Genera un video cinematográfico de 30 segundos, consistente entre planos, basado en la parodia tierna y épica de Don Quijote y Sancho contra el molino, protagonizada por gatitos. Usa exclusivamente las hojas de personaje adjuntas como referencia obligatoria para Don Quijote gatito caballero, Sancho gatito escudero y sus dos burritos. Mantén exactamente los diseños, vestuario, armadura, ropajes y monturas de las referencias.
Ambientación: paisaje manchego realista, camino rural serpenteante, colinas suaves, terreno seco, hierba amarillenta, piedras, horizonte abierto, atmósfera castellana, luz de tarde suave. No mostrar molinos en los primeros planos ni al inicio. Solo revelar el molino después del choque. Estilo visual realista, cinematográfico, adorable, con burritos algo más realistas y menos caricaturescos. Sin diálogo.
Secuencia:
Plano 1. Plano lateral medio de ambos cabalgando de perfil por el camino, Don Quijote delante sobre el burrito un poco más alto y Sancho detrás sobre el burrito más bajo. Avanzan tranquilos y cansados, especialmente Sancho.
Plano 2. Don Quijote se detiene en seco, frena el burrito y mira fijamente al horizonte con expresión intensa.
Plano 3. Sancho, confundido y contrariado, baja del burrito sin entender qué ocurre.
Plano 4. Don Quijote desmonta y avanza unos pasos con su lanza. Una sombra enorme empieza a cubrirlo.
Plano 5. Cuando queda completamente cubierto por la sombra, se detiene y adopta una pose heroica, recta y quieta, con la lanza erguida. Sopla un viento fuerte que agita sutilmente su capa y su pelo.
Plano 6. Don Quijote entra en posición de ataque y embiste con decisión hacia un objetivo fuera de cámara.
Plano 7. Se revela el impacto: embiste contra la pared blanca de un molino de viento tradicional manchego, rebota y cae boca arriba al suelo, aturdido.
Plano 8. Plano abierto donde se ve a Don Quijote tumbado delante del molino, diminuto y derrotado.
Plano 9. Plano final de Sancho negando con la cabeza, frustrado, cerrando con humor tierno.
Importante: máxima consistencia visual entre planos, misma localización, misma luz, misma orientación, mismo diseño de personajes. Don Quijote siempre lleva una lanza, no una espada. Sancho mantiene su bastón. El tono debe ser una mezcla de épica, ternura y comedia visual.
10. EVITAR
No mostrar molinos antes del golpe.
No cambiar el diseño de los personajes entre planos.
No volver caricaturescos los burritos.
No hacer movimientos de cámara exagerados.
No introducir elementos modernos.
No convertir la escena en slapstick caótico; debe seguir sintiéndose cinematográfica."

Each character sheet shows multiple views of ONE person. Render one complete woman and one complete man, both with intact heads. Preserve their reference faces, proportions, skin tones, hair, wardrobe, accessories and painterly material treatment precisely. The woman's brass instrument remains on her anatomical LEFT forearm. Match the man's shoulder armor to his actual reference image. The reference images take priority over inferred costume details.

Preserve the references’ sculpted, hand-painted animation aesthetic: angular facial planes, visible brush textures, selective sharp edges, rich violet shadows, turquoise ambient light and warm copper highlights. Dimensional animated filmmaking, not live-action or glossy plastic rendering.

SCENE AND GEOGRAPHY
Inside the referenced abandoned pumping station, the enormous pump wheel stands beneath the rear arched window. Canal railing stays left, furnace and staircase stay right. Keep the existing architecture recognizable.

The woman stands screen-left at a waist-high brass control socket attached to the pump housing. The man stands screen-right, one step behind her, holding down a stiff mechanical safety lever with his RIGHT hand. Both faces are visible in the first frame. Her left forearm instrument is already aligned with the socket; her right hand supports its casing.

They are trying to restart the station together. She needs his trust; he needs her to finish without getting hurt.

FOUR SHOTS — EXACTLY 10 SECONDS
Hard cuts at 2.2, 4.3 and 7.0 seconds. One clear camera movement per shot. Maintain the woman-left / man-right screen relationship and stay on the same side of their interaction axis.

SHOT 1 — 0.0–2.2s
Low, wide two-shot, seen just above a shallow foreground puddle. Both characters and the dormant wheel are readable immediately. A short lateral camera slide clears a foreground pipe, revealing their full working relationship.

The woman presses her left forearm instrument into the socket. Before committing, she checks the man's face to see whether he will keep holding the lever. He meets her look and deliberately braces his weight against it. She turns her attention back to the connection. A thin cyan seam lights inside the socket.

HARD CUT.

SHOT 2 — 2.2–4.3s
Intimate medium close-up from beside the pump housing: her face dominates the left foreground, his face remains readable behind her on the right. A restrained forward push closes the distance.

Cyan light climbs from the connected instrument onto her cheek. She watches the mechanism for a response, then checks him again, seeking acknowledgment that it worked. His attention moves past her toward a vibrating pressure coupling beside the wheel. His grip tightens on the safety lever. The mechanical hum becomes uneven; a bolt rattles visibly in its seat.

HARD CUT ON THE METALLIC SNAP.

SHOT 3 — 4.3–7.0s
Low, wide side view with both full bodies visible from the first frame. A fast, short backward tracking move makes room for their retreat.

The coupling vents a single forceful jet of white steam above shoulder height, aimed toward the empty foreground, not into either face. The woman recoils one step, disengaging her forearm instrument from the socket. The man releases the lever and catches her RIGHT upper arm with his LEFT hand, guiding her behind his shoulder as he takes one grounded step back.

Their boots displace shallow water. Her jacket hem and his long coat respond to the pressure with delayed fabric movement. The heavy pump wheel begins turning behind them. The danger is brief and physically localized, not an explosion that destroys the room.

HARD CUT.

SHOT 4 — 7.0–10.0s
Medium-wide two-shot from the same side of the action axis. The woman remains left and the man right; the rear arch and distant city are visible between and above them. A smooth backward dolly widens the composition.

He releases her arm once she has her footing. She briefly meets his eyes, checking whether he still trusts her. Before either can settle, a deep mechanical pulse sounds beyond the station. He notices the distant response first; she follows his gaze a fraction later.

Beyond the arch, three successive clusters of amber windows switch on across the previously dark city, traveling away into the distance. Their successful repair has awakened a larger connected system. Both turn toward it, their partnership now facing a new question.

End with the wheel still turning, water trembling and their attention fixed on the awakening city. No freeze-frame or fade to black.

ACTING TASK
Shared direction: complete the restart together without abandoning each other.

Woman: win his continued cooperation by making the machine respond. Her obstacle is that the machinery becomes dangerous just as she proves her point. Pursue his trust through purposeful checks of his face; after the rescue, assess his response instead of celebrating or posing.

Man: give her the chance to succeed while keeping her within reach. His obstacle is that protecting her may require interrupting the experiment. First support her by holding the lever; then redirect her physically out of danger. Afterward, check her footing before investigating the distant sound.

Keep attention engaged with the partner or the active mechanism. Natural blinks, responsive breathing, no fixed smiles, synchronized reactions or blank heroic stares.

LIGHT, PHYSICS AND SOUND
Maintain turquoise window light from rear-left and warm furnace light from the right. The cyan activation adds localized illumination to nearby skin and brass; it does not replace the established lighting. Preserve face readability through the steam.

Bodies retain weight and traction. The man guides rather than throws her. Machinery accelerates with inertia. Steam disperses and wet footprints persist across cuts. Painted highlights and moving shadows follow the same stable character forms.

Audio: water drips, strained lever creak, electrical resonance, one sharp metal snap, a short steam blast, wet footfalls, accelerating gears, then a distant low mechanical response from the city. Brief natural exertion breaths. No dialogue or vocals.

Exactly two characters throughout. No additional figures, costume changes, identity swaps, duplicated bodies, floating accessories, text, subtitles, logos or reference-sheet layouts.

prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT
Late night inside a dark government analysis office. A lone analyst sits at a desk facing a computer monitor, reviewing a live CCTV surveillance grid. He discovers that one of the feeds shows him, from behind, in real time. Then the figure on the screen turns to face the camera while he himself stays perfectly still. Total length 30 seconds, built as a chain of rapid hooks.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
@Image 1: man in his early 40s, analyst, medium athletic build, tired and focused. Short black hair swept back, thin mustache connected to a short chin goatee, deep-set brown eyes, weathered skin texture. Black short-sleeve piqué polo shirt with a three-button placket, black slim jeans, black sneakers. 100% matches the reference in face, hair and wardrobe in every shot.

LOCATION MAP
Foreground: the top edge of a dark computer monitor, out of focus, filling the lower 30% of frame as a black-teal band. Midground: @Image 1 seated at the desk, face rising just above the monitor edge, centered. Background: deep open-plan office dissolving into near-black teal shadow, faint rectangles of switched-off monitors, a glass partition 6 meters behind him. A small dome security camera is mounted high on the ceiling, upper-left from the camera, barely visible. The only motivated light comes from his monitor in front of him and below him, plus a cold practical spill from a distant corridor behind him.

FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING
Frame 1: centered close-up of @Image 1's face, visible only from the eyebrows down to the nose and upper lip, rising above the blurred dark monitor edge. His eyes already move left-to-right, reading. Symmetrical, centered composition, with heavy negative space above his head.

FORMAT MODE
Timed multishot, 2.39:1 widescreen. Cuts only at the specified points; the camera does not cut on its own.

OPTICS
Long-lens portrait character throughout, shallow depth of field, soft spherical bokeh, fine prime-lens sharpness on the eyes. FOV is set per segment. No drift mid-segment.

CAMERA
Mostly locked-off, with a slow creeping push where stated. Eye-level with his eyes, operator on the shadow side, axis straight on. Tonal character: wide latitude, deep shadows that keep detail, soft highlight roll-off on the screen-lit skin, clean digital texture.

ACTION
0.0s to 3.0s — CU, 18°. Locked-off, centered, matching the first frame. His eyes scan the screen, then stop dead on one point. The monitor light flickers across his face as the feed refreshes.
3.0s HARD CUT
3.0s to 6.0s — INSERT, 12°. The monitor screen fills the frame: a 3×3 grid of grainy night CCTV feeds of empty corridors and offices, each with a small white timestamp. The center-right tile shows a dark office with a man seated at a glowing monitor, seen from behind and above.
6.0s HARD CUT
6.0s to 9.0s — ECU, 12°. His right hand on the mouse, lit teal from the screen. His index finger double-clicks. The cursor's reflection slides across his wedding-ring-free knuckles.
9.0s HARD CUT
9.0s to 13.0s — WS observation shot, 8°. Shot from far behind the glass partition: @Image 1 alone at his desk, small in frame, the only lit point in the dark office. A blurred partition edge covers 25% of frame on camera-left. Haze is visible at 10 meters depth. The camera holds still with a 1 cm handheld tremor, like a hidden watcher.
13.0s HARD CUT
13.0s to 17.0s — INSERT, 18°. The enlarged CCTV feed fills the screen in high-angle black-and-white grain: a man in a black polo at a glowing monitor, seen from behind. The timestamp ticks live, "23:47:12 → 23:47:15". He is in the same office, at the same desk.
17.0s HARD CUT
17.0s to 21.0s — CU, 18°. Back on @Image 1's centered face above the monitor edge. Slow push-in at 0.5 km/h. He slowly raises his right hand to shoulder height, testing, his eyes locked on the screen.
21.0s HARD CUT
21.0s to 25.0s — INSERT, 18°. The CCTV feed: the figure on screen raises its right hand one full second late. Then the figure lowers the hand, slowly turns its head over its shoulder, and looks straight up into the security camera lens.
25.0s HARD CUT
25.0s to 30.0s — ECU, 12°. His eyes and the bridge of his nose only, underlit by the screen. His body stays completely still. Only his eyes travel up and to camera-left, toward the ceiling corner behind the monitor where the dome camera hangs. At 29.0s the monitor turns off and his face drops into darkness, leaving only a faint teal catch-light in both eyes for one second. Cut to black at 30.0s.

ACTING TASK — @Image 1 (he is fully invested in his tactic; the work happens in his eyes):
SCENE DIRECTION (shared, unspoken): stay the professional, verify before reacting.
MOTIVE (his fuel): if this is real, the one who notices it calmly is the one who survives it.
GOAL: prove to himself it is a glitch, a loop, a recording, anything but live.
OBSTACLE: the timestamp keeps ticking in real time, and every check he runs makes it more true.
TACTIC: he tests the feed the way an analyst tests evidence. His eyes run between his own hand and the screen, comparing timing frame by frame, hunting for the lag that would expose a recording. When the figure looks up, his eyes do not panic. They calculate where the lens must be, then go find it.
Moment to moment:
— reading the grid — eyes sorting tile by tile, filing each as normal, until one refuses to be filed.
— raising the hand — eyes split between the hand's position and the screen, measuring the delay.
— the figure turns — eyes freeze for one beat, then begin the hunt for the real camera.
(Safety: gaze always engaged in the task, never a frozen, glassy, unfocused stare; natural blink cadence.)

PERFORMANCE
Restraint throughout, minimal facial movement. Pore-level skin realism and fine stubble texture. Faint sweat sheen at the temple appears only from 17s onward. Breath is held during the hand test and released through the nose after 25s. Living wet eyes catch the monitor light.

PHYSICS
The polo fabric creases naturally at the shoulder when he raises his arm. The mouse slides with real friction. Monitor light falls off on his skin with distance, brightest under the chin and nose. Dust particles drift slowly through the corridor spill light in the wide shot.

LIGHTING
Key: the monitor from below and in front, an underlight that lifts his chin, nostrils and cheekbones and leaves his forehead in falloff. Backlight: a cold corridor spill behind him draws a thin rim on his hair and shoulders. No fill, deep shadows. The face is exposed one stop under, and the screen-lit eyes sit as the brightest point on the face. White balance is 5600K with the monitor rendered cyan-teal.

COLOR GRADE
Cool, desaturated teal-blue. Near-black shadows lean deep green-teal like dark bottle glass. The monitor glow is a saturated petrol-teal hitting the skin, and the skin stays muted and slightly cool. The black polo sinks into the shadows with only a teal sheen on the fabric ridges. The CCTV inserts are cold monochrome grain with a faint green tint.

AUDIO
Low electrical hum of the office. A soft computer fan. Two clean mouse clicks at 7s. A sub-bass drone rises from 13s. Total silence from 21.0s to 24.5s, broken by a single sharp electronic tick as the figure looks up. A low hit when the screen goes black at 29s.

STYLE
Photoreal paranoid political-thriller look, grounded and procedural, 2.39:1 widescreen, fine organic digital grain, crisp center sharpness with soft edges.

OUTPUT SETTINGS
2.39:1, 24 fps real-time throughout. 8K detail intent.

POSITIVE LOCKS
@Image 1's face, hair and black polo stay identical in every shot and in the CCTV feed. Face shots stay centered with the dark monitor edge filling the lower 30% of frame. The monitor is the only key light in every interior close-up. The timestamps remain small, white and legible. The office stays dark and empty apart from him. Cuts only at the stated seconds.

prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic 16:9 1080p live-action video filmed like casual handheld footage by a friend using an older digital camera.

A young French woman in her early 20s, with long naturally loose dark-brown hair, wears a dark green knit sweater, black wide-leg trousers, white sneakers, and carries a small burgundy handbag. Keep her face, identity, hairstyle, outfit, proportions, and handbag identical throughout.

LOCATION: A small independent movie theater in Lyon, France, around 8:30 PM. The theater is almost completely empty. Red fabric seats, dark carpet, narrow aisles, dim wall lights, small ticket counter, fictional movie posters, projector-room window, and a quiet lobby. Use only fictional movie titles and posters.

CAMERA: Raw handheld consumer-camera footage. Slight natural shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, exposure adjustment, mild digital noise, natural motion blur and compression. No stabilization, cinematic bokeh, professional lighting, smooth tracking, or commercial/trailer aesthetic.

0-5s , EMPTY LOBBY  
Camera follows her through the nearly empty lobby. She looks around and quietly says, “We're really early.” She smiles and enters the screening room.

5-10s , FINDING A SEAT  
She walks down the aisle and chooses a middle seat. She sits naturally, compressing the fabric seat, and places her burgundy handbag beside her.

10-15s , PROJECTOR  
She looks toward the screen. A realistic projector beam cuts through the darkness, with dust visible only inside the beam. She looks at the camera and whispers, “Look at that.” Camera tilts slightly toward the projector.

15-20s , POPCORN  
She notices a half-empty popcorn bucket on a nearby empty seat. She picks it up, looks confused, and says, “Someone forgot this.” She places it on the floor beside the seat.

20-25s , LIGHTS DIM  
The theater lights suddenly become darker. The projector becomes brighter and softly illuminates her face. She looks around briefly, then settles into her seat.

25-30s , QUIET MOMENT  
Camera stays behind her shoulder as she watches the screen. Only soft fictional screen light illuminates her face. She briefly turns and smiles at the camera. Autofocus becomes slightly soft as the camera moves, then the video ends naturally.

AUDIO: Natural theater ambience only,quiet footsteps, carpet movement, seat sounds, fabric movement, distant lobby sounds, projector fan, electrical hum, room echo, and quiet whispers. NO background music. Movie audio must be indistinct and completely original.

REALISM: Physically accurate projector light, dust, shadows, seat compression, handbag deformation, hair and clothing movement, and screen illumination. No recognizable movie footage or dialogue.

NEGATIVE PROMPT: CGI, animation, 3D render, plastic skin, beauty filter, face morphing, identity drift, extra fingers, malformed hands, duplicated people, floating objects, impossible lighting, fake projector beam, excessive HDR, oversaturation, artificial bokeh, cinematic trailer look, perfect stabilization, exaggerated acting, horror effects, wardrobe changes, hairstyle changes, continuity errors, subtitles, captions, logos, watermarks, real movie posters, copyrighted footage, copyrighted dialogue, copyrighted music.
